Midweek Motley (Southenders)

College Station, TX · South College Station · Road

Midweek Motley (Southenders) is a road group ride in College Station, TX. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:30 am from 1862 Rock Prairie / Pebble Creek entrance (two starts).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive

Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Midweek Motley (Southenders) group ride

A weekday morning road ride from the south side of College Station, listed by Brazos Valley Cyclists. Two start points, Rock Prairie and the Pebble Creek entrance. The same group runs Friday Follies and a Saturday ride at the same hour.
